verdict.rationale: Drive's API supports building custom triggers via push notifications on file/folder changes and even building AI agent add-ons that integrate with ADK/Vertex AI Agent Engine, which developers could use to construct background automations, but there is no native, user-facing automation builder (e.g., no-code rules, scheduled agentic workflows) within Drive itself. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in automation/workflow feature for end users, evidence of autonomous scheduled agent execution without custom coding, independent confirmation of such automations working reliably.
